sn35.115:1.1: santi bhikkhave cakkhuviññeyyā rūpā, iṭṭhā kantā manāpā piyarūpā kāmūpasaṃhitā rajanīyā.
sn35.115:1.2: tañce bhikkhu abhinandati abhivadati ajjhosāya tiṭṭhati.
sn35.115:1.3: ayaṃ vuccati bhikkhave bhikkhu baddho cakkhuviññeyyesu rūpesu, āvāsagato mārassa, mārassa vasaṅgato,
sn35.115:2.1: santi bhikkhave, sotaviññeyyā saddā …pe… ghānaviññeyyā gandhā …pe… jivhāviññeyyā rasā …pe… kāyaviññeyyā phoṭṭhabbā …pe…
sn35.115:2.3: tañce bhikkhu abhinandati abhivadati ajjhosāya tiṭṭhati.
sn35.115:2.4: ayaṃ vuccati bhikkhave bhikkhu baddho manoviññeyyesu dhammesu āvāsagato mārassa, mārassa vasaṅgato,
sn35.115:3.1: santi ca kho bhikkhave cakkhuviññeyyā rūpā, iṭṭhā kantā manāpā piyarūpā kāmūpasaṃhitā rajanīyā.
sn35.115:3.2: tañce bhikkhu nābhinandati nābhivadati nājjhosāya tiṭṭhati.
sn35.115:3.3: ayaṃ vuccati bhikkhave bhikkhu, mutto cakkhuviññeyyehi rūpehi, na āvāsagato mārassa, na mārassa vasaṅgato,
sn35.115:4.1: santi bhikkhave sotaviññeyyā saddā …pe… ghānaviññeyyā gandhā …pe… jivhāviññeyyā rasā …pe… kāyaviññeyyā phoṭṭhabbā …pe…
sn35.115:4.2: santi bhikkhave manoviññeyyā dhammā, iṭṭhā kantā manāpā piyarūpā kāmūpasaṃhitā rajanīyā.
sn35.115:4.3: tañce bhikkhu nābhinandati nābhivadati nājjhosāya tiṭṭhati.
sn35.115:4.4: ayaṃ vuccati bhikkhave bhikkhu mutto manoviññeyyehi dhammehi, na āvāsagato mārassa, na mārassa vasaṅgato,
